text: 你不敢触碰那令人作呕的尸体，便用枯枝把它撬进沟里。你砍些灌木盖住它，然后回到洞穴。到了早晨，继续赶路似乎安全了。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 509
text: Fearing to touch the repulsive carcass, you use a dead branch to lever it into a ditch. You cut some shrubs to cover it and then return to the cave. By morning it appears safe to continue on your way.
